narr: A slow moving and back building band of showers and thunderstorms produced early morning flash flooding in the Grapeland area of Houston County.
ev: Heavy rains produce flash flooding in and around the Grapeland area. A water rescue was performed along FM 228 approximately two miles east of Grapeland after a car was swept off the road by floodwaters.
Flash flooding caused a washout in one lane of FM 2423 between County Road 1840 and US Highway 287 North.
lsr: SWIFT WATER RESCUE WAS MADE ALONG FM228 APPROXIMATELY 2 MILES EAST OF GRAPELAND AFTER A CAR WAS SWEPT OFF THE ROAD BY FLOODWATERS.
TEXAS DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION REPORTS A WASHOUT IN ONE LANE OF FM 2423 BETWEEN COUNTY ROAD 1840 AND US HIGHWAY 287 NORTH DUE TO FLASH FLOODING.
